trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. It is the last trophy by definition: there is no separate task behind it, so plan the whole run around the other 54 and let this one arrive when they are done.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so this trophy unlocks naturally as you play; nothing special is needed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Before you leave the chapter, do the one-time meditation with Lucia at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) and keep a save from inside Chapter 1, because there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2. From the mission Coffee Break onward you can free roam with both protagonists, switch between them, and call your partner to join you — this is when the open-world trophies properly open up.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. Nothing here needs a special setup; the chapter trophy pops when the story moves on.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. Keep a save at the start and the end of the chapter, as PowerPyx advises for every chapter, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. After the ending, the 100% Completion entry appears under Progress > Stats, which is where the post-story cleanup begins.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks in the course of the story; play the missions in order and it will come.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story mission, so no preparation outside the story is needed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks in the course of the story.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks in the course of the story.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at the airport. It unlocks in the course of the story.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks in the course of the story.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Finish the in-game 100% Completion checklist, which appears under Progress > Stats after the story. PowerPyx rates the platinum 4 out of 10 and about 200 hours, and calls this the hardest trophy. The checklist wants every robbery, every underwater discovery, all shooting ranges, all drone races and Bret's quest — but most side quests are not required and collectibles count only partly. It also needs 70 of the 80 Challenges and 15 of the 18 meditations. Work through it last, after the story and the open-world trophies, and check the Progress menu often: Push Square notes you can track almost everything from Touch Pad > Progress.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: PowerPyx — 100% Completion Checklist; Push Square — Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps. There are 130 stunt jump locations; find them on the map under Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots and track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 if you are aiming for A Long Road.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Push Square — Trophy Guide; PowerPyx — Stunt locations

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race or drone race, and a stunt. None of them has to be won or finished — one try each is enough, so sample them early and this pops quickly.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are two ranges: Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero and Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn; find them under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges. At each range, buy the $5 waiver pass from the clerk inside before the challenges appear on the map. Each challenge is a timed course or a target score. Do the ranges before going for Gunslinger: they raise your Focus stat, which makes Combat Focus kills easier. Track progress under Activities > Shooting Ranges.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Push Square — Trophy Guide; WeHunt — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location runs three races; beat the par time to win. Work through the locations one by one — a win at each of the 14 is what counts, not every race at every location.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: WeHunt — GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Push Square — Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations. Any 20 will do, so pick the short, easy ones first and spread them across the map rather than grinding one circuit.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Go fishing, find Cal's challenge, and out-fish him. Fishing also counts toward Master of None, so try it early.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all levels of one arcade game. There are 4 playable video games; playing each one once is also part of the 100% checklist, so sample all four and then finish your favourite right through to its last level.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Side-character strands unlock as the story progresses; keep doing Andy's missions whenever they appear and the finale will come.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Keep taking Kenton's missions as they appear.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Keep taking Billy's missions as they appear.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear on the map as you explore; talk to them and follow each strand to its end. Eight finished strands is the count, so do not stop after the first few.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Keep taking Randy's missions as they appear.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Keep taking Tyrone's missions as they appear.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots. There are 10 locations: 8 outdoor spots you must complete once with each protagonist (16 completions), plus the first meditation at Jason's house and the final one at the Mount Kalaga summit. THE MISSABLE ONE: one morning in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house and walks out to the balcony. Follow her, accept the prompt, and she teaches you to meditate. This chance disappears after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it — do it anyway and keep a save from inside Chapter 1 until you are sure. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, but this trophy needs every spot. Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, and find spots on the map under Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida; the summit marker appears only after the other meditations are done.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: GTADB — Meditation Spots; PowerPyx — Trophy Roadmap; Push Square — Trophy Guide

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's quest is also part of the 100% checklist, so do it when his missions come up rather than leaving it for the end.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. There are 480 unique cards in total, so pick the three smallest sets and hunt those cards first; you do not need all 18 sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK app: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. Open the WAiNK app and scan as you travel — every landmark you pass is a free scan, so this builds up naturally while you explore, and a scan also counts toward discovering vehicles for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 Challenges. There are 8 categories with 10 challenges each; the easy early ones in each category add up fast. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so keep going past 50 if you are aiming for A Long Road.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Call your partner to join you first (available from Chapter 2), get the police to 4 stars, then break line of sight and hide until the heat dies down.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Pick three shops close together, keep your partner with you, and move from one to the next without letting the wanted level drop in between.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan is enough to count a vehicle as discovered, so scan every new vehicle you pass while travelling — this pairs naturally with You WAiNKer!.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Do the shooting ranges first: they raise your Focus stat, which gives you more Focus time to work with. Then find a spot with at least 5 enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it runs out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. Get to the airfield, take a plane, and leave without a scheduled flight — the trophy is about leaving on your own terms.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by any published guide, so treat this one as open: engage Rhinos when you meet them at high wanted levels and check the trophy list after. Do not rely on a single unverified method.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and sightlines, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Plan the getaway before you go in: a fast car parked nearby matters more than the robbery itself. Five successful vault jobs, each with a clean escape, is the count.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush one on the road, take the cash, and lose the wanted level before the trophy pops — the escape is part of the condition.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map, all 52 areas. Drive, fly and walk everywhere: the map fills in as you travel, so combine this with races, stunts and WAiNK scans and it will finish on its own. Check the map for the last foggy patches at the end.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find each gang's operation on the map, hit it, and repeat for all nine — the count is gangs, not operations, so one per gang is enough.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger for this one yet — gamemapa lists it among the five still-unsolved trophies. The description points at a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach: try the beachfront bars at sunset and watch for the prompt. Treat any method you find online as unconfirmed until a second source agrees.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger for this one yet — gamemapa lists it among the five still-unsolved trophies. The description points at smashing out of a vehicle showroom: try driving a car through a showroom's front window. Treat any method you find online as unconfirmed until a second source agrees.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl. Follow through on the game there — play a full game at the alley and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger for this one yet. The description points at a partnership moment with mass appeal — most likely a co-op activity with your partner that draws a crowd. Try partner activities that play to an audience and check the trophy list after. Treat any method you find online as unconfirmed until a second source agrees.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Everything you do that moves the profile counts — robberies, getaways, stunts, choices in missions. It builds up across the whole game, so keep playing naturally and check the profile counter under Progress; do not grind it early.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger for this one yet — gamemapa lists it among the five still-unsolved trophies. The description hints at succeeding on a second try: retry something you failed once and succeed the second time. Treat any method you find online as unconfirmed until a second source agrees.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger for this one yet — gamemapa lists it among the five still-unsolved trophies. The description hints at witnessing something strange, most likely a random odd event somewhere in Leonida. Keep an eye out while exploring and check the trophy list after strange encounters. Treat any method you find online as unconfirmed until a second source agrees.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. The precise method is still being confirmed by the published guides, so the safe version is: drive past someone slowly and hit them with a melee attack from the vehicle. If it does not pop, try different speeds and weapons and check the trophy list after each attempt.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (method being confirmed)

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; hand them to your contacts to clean them, and the total adds up across the whole game — keep laundering as you earn.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades all count, so buy what you actually use as you play and the total will reach $100,000 on its own — no need to waste money on purpose.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are useful anyway for storing vehicles, so buy them as you can afford them and the trophy pops with the last one.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you like, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one — ten registrations is the count.
trophies.name: On the Spot
